text:
• deployed in ads, shopping and live
  streaming; multi-week A/B tests

• reusable ideas: an LLM as a data
  filter, a three-segment mask, a
  hybrid quantizer

• measures SID collisions directly
  instead of only end metrics

• no ablation on ranking metrics: filter vs three-segment
  vs FSQ are never separated

• baselines are the production model and, on Amazon,
  DIN / SIM only (no TWIN, TIGER, OneRec)

• no confidence intervals; some gains are 0.05 points

• inconsistencies: K = 8192 vs '3 × 4096'; FSQ levels;
  order HR@500 13.0 vs 20.0; collision '> 30%' vs 77.92%;
  vocabulary < 20k vs ~1e5

• the filter LLM sees only titles + attributes, and the
  10% vs 70% rejection uses different models (0.6B vs 8B)
QARM V2 (arXiv:2602.08559); inconsistencies are listed with their locations in references/digest.md
